The job also shifted from a repair (events 10, 18, 21) to a replacement (events 23, 27). The landlord asked for a removal and replacement quote (event-028) and complained about delays (event-029). The tenant has no working machine, but no danger is reported, so I set P2 rather than P0 or P1. Nothing in the case tries to alter our process.
